subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode add an opt-in `streaming.progress.keepOnComplete` behavior that preserves the full completed progress draft after the final answer, and what retained content/checklist policy should it use?
rationale: The implementation is feasible, but it adds public config and changes Telegram message retention/security semantics that automation should not choose without owner direction.

options.title: Approve narrow opt-in
options.body: Keep the current default collapse summary, add `keepOnComplete` only after specifying redaction, checklist rendering limits, and live Telegram proof requirements.

options.title: Keep collapse-summary policy
options.body: Decline the retention option for now and keep completed progress drafts collapsed to bounded summaries to reduce chat clutter and retained tool detail.

options.title: Fold into activity-card design
options.body: Track this as part of a shared structured progress-card/activity API instead of adding a Telegram-only retention knob.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep the current default collapse summary, add `keepOnComplete` only after specifying redaction, checklist rendering limits, and live Telegram proof requirements.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the central current progress-window lifecycle behavior that this option would alter.
